name: Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF)
tagline: Defending civil liberties and user rights in the digital world
description: EFF is the leading nonprofit organization defending civil liberties in the digital world. Founded in 1990, EFF champions user privacy, free expression, and innovation through litigation, policy analysis, grassroots activism, and technology development.
impactMetrics: Defending privacy & encryption rights for 4+ billion global internet users

name: Girls Who Code
tagline: Closing the gender gap in entry-level tech and computer science
description: Girls Who Code is on a mission to close the gender gap in technology and change the image of what a programmer looks like and does. They have reached over 500,000 girls and young women through computer science clubs, summer programs, and college loops.
impactMetrics: 500,000+ students taught; alumni major in CS at 7x the US average

name: Internet Archive
tagline: Universal access to all knowledge and the open digital commons
description: Building a digital library of Internet sites and other cultural artifacts in digital form. Like a paper library, they provide free access to researchers, historians, scholars, people with print disabilities, and the general public.
impactMetrics: 830+ billion web pages preserved; free access for millions daily

name: TechSoup
tagline: Equipping non-profits and changemakers with tech resources
description: TechSoup equips changemakers with transformative technology solutions and skills they need to improve lives globally and locally. They facilitate tech donations, hardware refurbishment, and software licensing for charities worldwide.
impactMetrics: $18+ billion in tech resources delivered to 1.4 million nonprofits

name: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT)
tagline: Mapping vulnerable communities using open-source geospatial tools
description: HOT creates open, collaborative map data for disaster response and socioeconomic development. When natural disasters hit, HOT mobilizes a global network of open-source volunteers to map affected areas from satellite imagery.
impactMetrics: 350,000+ volunteer mappers aiding first responders in 100+ countries

name: Black Girls CODE
tagline: Empowering girls of color to become future tech leaders and innovators
description: Dedicated to proving to the world that girls of color can code, lead, and create the technologies of tomorrow through hands-on workshops in web architecture, robotics, gaming, and AI.
impactMetrics: Over 100,000 girls engaged across 15+ metropolitan chapters

name: Climate TRACE
tagline: Harnessing satellite data & AI to track global emissions in real time
description: A global coalition of tech non-profits and data scientists leveraging AI, remote sensing, and satellite imagery to independently track greenhouse gas emissions worldwide with facility-level precision.
impactMetrics: Tracking 352+ million emission sources globally with open satellite data

name: freeCodeCamp
tagline: Free, accessible computer science education for anyone, anywhere
description: A 501(c)(3) donor-supported charity that helps millions of people learn to code for free. freeCodeCamp has helped over 40,000 people land their first developer jobs at leading technology organizations.
impactMetrics: 10,000+ free coding tutorials; 40k+ career transitions enabled

name: Center for Inclusive Design & Accessibility
tagline: Building an accessible, assistive web for people with disabilities
description: Advancing digital accessibility standards and building open-source assistive technologies that make software and web tools usable for people of all abilities.
impactMetrics: Setting WCAG web accessibility guidelines powering 1B+ accessible web experiences
